measurement.isolation: One operation per sequential fresh subprocess; reference in separate child.
measurement.timing: Cold kernel after imports and case/model setup; no warmup.
measurement.memory: Absolute ru_maxrss high-water RSS includes interpreter, imports and setup. Import/setup marks are separate high-water marks, NOT incremental operation memory.
measurement.guard: Whitelist, P<=64, estimated design/tangent bytes, per-child timeout; estimate is not a bound on interpreter/runtime RSS; no RLIMIT_AS.
measurement.contrast_covariance: Same 2-row C: group intercept difference and global moderator. Original: assemble H, full fisher_covariance, C V C.T; improved: assemble information_operator, projected solves.
measurement.reference: Unsimplified float64 autodiff observed Hessian; solve for covariance.
measurement.autodiff: torch.autograd.functional.hessian; reverse-mode row-wise Hessian, no separate score calculation.
measurement.independent_closed: Optional helper evaluate() computes value, score and Hessian together.
measurement.inference: Performance or matching Hessians does not establish statistical calibration.
